bio: It isn’t easy to nab a table in this luxury brasserie, which is always a sign of top-notch quality. Daefnis specialises in first-rate produce: North Sea sole, lamb shoulder and Hereford côte à l'os are just a few of the delicacies that are showcased on the up-to-date brasserie menu. Familiar flavours are nonetheless respected, albeit with judicious nuances....
